# apple_subscription_offer_code_custom_code (Resource)

Manages a custom code for an `apple_subscription_offer_code`: one string, such as `SCHOOL2026`, that many customers redeem, up to `number_of_codes` times in all. It is the shape for a code printed in a newsletter or read out at a school; for codes handed to one person each, use `apple_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code`.

~> **A code string is held for as long as it is active.** App Store Connect refuses a custom code that another active offer of the same app already uses, and allows it again once that one is deactivated. Because a replacement deactivates the old record before creating the new one, changing `number_of_codes` or `expiration_date` re-issues the same string — but every attribute except `active` is fixed at creation, so any change replaces the code, and redemptions already counted against the old record do not carry over.

~> **Nothing here can be deleted.** App Store Connect API 4.5.1 publishes no `DELETE` for an offer code, a custom code or a batch of one-time-use codes. `terraform destroy` **deactivates** the record (`active = false`), warns, and drops it from state; the record and its codes stay in App Store Connect forever. App Store Connect's help says a deactivated offer "can't be reactivated later" and that every code under it is invalidated, so deactivating — by destroy, by a replacement, or by setting `active = false` — is final for the codes customers already hold.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_offer_code" "schools" {
  subscription_id        = "6740021496"
  name                   = "Schools 2026"
  customer_eligibilities = ["NEW"]
  offer_eligibility      = "STACK_WITH_INTRO_OFFERS"
  duration               = "ONE_MONTH"
  offer_mode             = "FREE_TRIAL"
  number_of_periods      = 1
  prices                 = [{ territory_id = "AUS" }]
}

# One string many teachers type: letters and digits only, up to 64. Up to
# 25,000 redemptions; an expiration date is optional and at most six months
# away.
resource "apple_subscription_offer_code_custom_code" "school2026" {
  offer_code_id   = apple_subscription_offer_code.schools.id
  custom_code     = "SCHOOL2026"
  number_of_codes = 5000
  expiration_date = "2027-03-31"
}

# Ending it early: active = false stops redemptions in place, for good, and
# frees the string for another offer of the app.
resource "apple_subscription_offer_code_custom_code" "pilot" {
  offer_code_id   = apple_subscription_offer_code.schools.id
  custom_code     = "PILOTSCHOOLS"
  number_of_codes = 100
  active          = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `custom_code` (String) The code customers type, up to 64 letters and digits — App Store Connect accepts no special characters. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `number_of_codes` (Number) How many times the code can be redeemed in all, from 1 to 25000. For more, create another custom code with the same string once this one is deactivated. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `offer_code_id` (String) The ID of the `apple_subscription_offer_code` this code redeems. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the code redeems. Defaults to `true`. Setting it to `false` ends it in place, releases the string for another offer of the app, and is **final**: a deactivated code cannot be turned back on, so setting it back to `true` plans a new custom code.
- `expiration_date` (String) The last day the code redeems, as a plain date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form — at most six months after it is created; codes expire at 12:00 a.m. Pacific Time on that date. Optional: a custom code without one does not expire. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) When Apple created the code.
- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the custom code.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The import ID is Apple's custom code ID; the offer it redeems is read back
# with it.
terraform import apple_subscription_offer_code_custom_code.school2026 8812345601
```
